title: Eggplant – Crispy and Roasted
description: You may be shocked to find that you love the texture of this dish. It is very easy, quick, and tasty. And, there are so many ways you could use these little crispy pieces once they are ready. They are awesome alongside some warm marinara sauce and Parmesan, sort of an appetizer or as a side dish plant, or a small meal suggestion. This is also great in stir fries or curries, or on top of pasta with red sauce and cheese. So basically, you’ll love the texture, but these go well with other awesome flavors or dishes that come with sauces.
directions: Peel the skin from the eggplant (optional), then chop into roughly 1-inch pieces (think bite-sized).
Generously sprinkle the pieces with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Then add to a bag or bowl and toss with the arrow root powder (or corn starch) until all pieces are well coated.

Drizzle a little olive oil to a baking sheet, add the eggplant, and bake at 400°F for 22-24 minutes. Halfway through the bake time, remove from the oven and flip each piece so they will more evenly bake and all sides will get crispy.
Now you’re ready to eat these as a simple side disk, add to a stir fry, curry, or pasta dish. Or warm up some marinara and serve these alongside as a little app.

This is best (the most crispy) the day it is made, but if you want to make this ahead and save stored in an airtight container, you can just re-crisp for about 5 minutes in a hot oven (around 400°F or even a bit higher).
